title: OXVA NeXLIM Pod Kit
description:
The
OXVA NeXLIM Pod Kit
is an advanced refillable open pod system featuring dual mesh coil technology, a 0.85" colour display, and adjustable wattage up to 40W. Boost mode delivers intense flavour while Eco mode extends coil life.
Product Type:
Open Pod System (Refillable)
Battery:
1500mAh
Wattage Range:
5-40W
Charging:
USB Type-C (2A Fast Charge)
Display:
0.85" TFT Colour Screen
E-Liquid Capacity:
4mL
Coil Resistance:
Integrated Dual Mesh
Airflow:
Adjustable (Side Slider)
Power Modes:
Boost Mode / Eco Mode
Pod Compatibility:
OXVA NeXLIM Pods (0.6Ω, 0.8Ω, 1.2Ω). Also compatible with XLIM V3 Pods via adaptor (sold separately).
Brand:
OXVA
